operations.name: read_random
operations.desc: Read random number from VirtIO RNG
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc100
add dx, 0x12
xor eax, eax
in al, dx
ret

operations.name: read_bar0_io
operations.desc: Read first register at BAR0 (I/O port)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc100
in eax, dx
ret
